model_or_product: Walco Fuzz Tone Generator / Bass-Treble Expander / Signal Booster / Sound-Go-Round
flag_note: Walco-Linck is documented as the U.S. company behind the Walco Electronics division, while surviving effects are Japanese-made. The Japanese OEM factory remains unidentified, so preserve Walco-Linck as the U.S. marketed/company entity rather than asserting it was the physical pedal factory.

Keio Giken is an earlier corporate identity in the Korg lineage, not a separate unrelated builder. The Synthesizer Traveler F-1 is documented as a circa-1972 Keio Giken-manufactured wah/fuzz product. Preserve Keio Giken as a historical corporate/manufacturer state under the Korg lineage.

A Japanese National-branded 1971 fuzz/wah is documented as manufactured by Shin-Ei Denki, reinforcing Shin-Ei's role as the physical manufacturer behind additional Japanese private-label effects. Keep National as the marketed identity.
